status: Small loss-trace diagnostic complete; descriptive only
interpretation: In this small traced sample, candidate losses against both damage-focused opponents were already behind in normalized total team HP and surviving Pokemon after the first resolved turn. The sample is only 12 team-pair clusters per opponent and the comparison is outcome-stratified; it does not establish that opening choices caused the losses. Use it to prioritize matched opening-state counterfactuals with repeated chance outcomes, then validate any policy change on fresh teams.
runtime_note: Trace-enabled evaluation ran at 3.42–3.71 games/s on four workers. Trace collection adds overhead; this is not comparable to ordinary evaluation throughput.
